name: Zvook NW0 tactical FPV sensor
description: Post-mounted 360 deg acoustic sensor for FPV drones, including fibre-optic FPV that emits no RF at all. Declared 150-450 m; the maker advises 400-600 m node spacing. IP67, 15-20 W.

detectRangeM.condition: 150 to 450 m on FPV drones; the lower bound is 150 m
detectRangeM.source: Militarnyi, Ukraine Develops Acoustic Detector for FPV Drones (ZVOOK NW0), quoting the company

classifyRangeM.condition: classification range — No separate classification range is published. The device's only output is an FPV-class decision (audible alarm plus a map symbol in the Zvook UI), so classification is modeled as available wherever detection is.
classifyRangeM.source: Ukraine Develops Acoustic Detector for FPV Drones
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 450 m at INFERRED REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.source: dev.ua, Ukrainian company ZVOOK has created an acoustic sensor to detect FPV drones by sound

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single acoustic node measures bearing at best, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Omnidirectional single-node sensor best read as presence-and-alarm; no bearing is published and none can be estimated for a single microphone.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: No elevation measurement is published for this acoustic node; not established by the public record.

noiseFloorDb.note: Planning factor: the detection threshold implied by this record's own refAcousticDb (75 dB at 1 m, FPV) and detectRangeM (150 m lower bound) under spherical spreading, 75 - 20 log10(150) = 31.5 dB re 20 µPa, recorded as 32 dB, so the reported 150 to 450 m is reproduced at its lower bound. Consistent with a bare omnidirectional node working at the 30 to 35 dBA rural ambient (Passmore, engrxiv preprint). Zvook publishes no threshold or ambient condition.
